rafters.read: Diagonal front rafter tips between the outer columns are readable in the monochrome old view. Correcting the sloping top to horizontal gives these dark valleys at native u positions. A short overrun at either end is attributed to the measured assembly.
rafters.geometry: 31 separate lengthwise rafters with splayed forward tips; exact ends partly hidden by branch or column. The field survey is photographic.

stairs.geometry: Six broad rising treads with a spreading front and elevated platform.
